audit.summary: The change accepts malformed Solana payout addresses that produce unusable sellers, and two readiness/setup paths do not fully satisfy the declared contract.

findings.title: Solana validation accepts non-public-key values
findings.consequence: A value such as 44 lowercase z characters passes this regex but decodes to 33 bytes rather than a 32-byte Solana public key, so cult build x402 generates a seller whose payout cannot be used for payment.

findings.title: Start does not install the pinned ACP version over an existing CLI
findings.consequence: When an older acp executable is already installed, cult start skips this pinned installation and leaves the user on the incompatible version that the release is intended to replace.

findings.title: Unknown Solana account status still passes readiness
findings.consequence: If the Solana RPC lookup times out while the payout lacks a USDC account, passed returns true and cult check reports the endpoint ready even though payments to that payout will fail.

limitations: Review was limited to the normalized issue, pull-request metadata, and supplied patches; repository code and tests were not executed.
